verdictHint.new: The version appears in the catalog after Apply.
verdictHint.present: This version is already in the catalog.
verdictHint.changed: A version with this number is already in the catalog, but its files differ in the source. A released version cannot be replaced: release a new one.
verdictHint.incompatible: The version needs a newer Studio or another pack format.
verdictHint.invalid: The pack check found errors, or the version files changed after release.
verdictHint.unreleased: The version is not in the source releases.yaml. Only released versions enter the catalog.

blocker.pack_conflict: A pack with this id is already in the catalog. One pack needs one source.
blocker.version_changed: The source changed a version that is already in the catalog. It cannot be replaced: projects pinned its files.
blocker.no_packs: The revision has no packs. Check the packs folder.

conflict.builtin: A pack with this id is built into the Studio. It can be connected only with “Replace built-in” checked.
conflict.other_source: A pack with this id already comes from the source “{{name}}”.
conflict.otherSourceUnknown: A pack with this id already comes from another source.
conflict.invalid: The pack cannot be read: fix the errors below.

report.label: Check report
report.ok_one: Ready to apply: {{count}} version will appear.
report.ok_other: Ready to apply: {{count}} versions will appear.
report.okNothing: Ready to apply, but nothing is new: all versions are already in the catalog.

applied.title: Catalog updated
applied.nothing: No new versions, the catalog did not change.

flow.running: Fetching the revision and reading the packs. This can take a couple of minutes.
flow.moved: The source changed after the check. Check it again to apply the fresh revision.
flow.busy: The source is already being checked or applied. Wait and check again.
